name: neo4j-cli
description: neo4j-cli — Neo4j graph database CLI. Run Cypher queries, manage database, import/export graph data.

install_steps: curl -LO https://neo4j.com/download/neo4j-desktop/linux/neo4j-cli-linux-amd64.zip && unzip -o neo4j-cli-linux-amd64.zip && sudo mv cypher-shell /usr/local/bin/ && rm neo4j-cli-linux-amd64.zip
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub or official packages.
